No investigate questions: for each fail, the code or the cited report shows the correct statement.

The fails, in short:
- F-106, scope: the entry says the native-wrapper generator wraps "every method". The code skips constructors and any method whose descriptor holds a byte, a short or an array (FortressMethodAdapter.java:215-225, SignatureParser.unsayable). Ledger row 368 states that exception.
- F-107, scope: the title names three heaps that run the interpreter. The body adds testFast's 4 GB for compiled run steps, which F-99 also states.
- F-108, scope: "On one core it is fixed". The judge's section 5 says the pinned runs change three flags at once (serial GC, tier 1, one processor) and corrects this exact wording. Ledger row 430 has the same wording.
- F-111, evidence and comprehension:
  - Its "Detail" pointer (climb-batch-workflow.md item 5 and :230) cites F-111 back, so the support is circular.
  - "the ENVGEN phase that only they run" is wrong: no phase order runs ENVGEN (PhaseOrder.java:133-134).
  - The "only" list leaves out the test harness and CacheBasedRepository through SimpleClassLoader.
  - "the texts" is not defined.
  - The title's claim itself holds by reading the code.
- F-112, evidence: its source, PLAN.md:402, now holds an unrelated item. The rule is recorded at PLAN-history.md:391 (dc0eee2fe), and a grep confirms that only IntLiteralArithRung7.fss:19 still cites a line.
- F-203, scope and evidence: checker-count/run.sh and distance/run.sh do not source env.sh. Their headers ask the caller to source it. run-subset.sh, run-ladder.sh, microgpt-phase.sh and setup.sh do source it.
- F-234, comprehension and scope:
  - It contrasts 6.4 % of the agents' lifetime with 47.8 % of the Bash wall time. The report's comparison is 17.5 % against 47.8 % of the Bash wall time, 2.7 times.
  - The 6.4 % is an upper bound.
  - "only a compiled test's run step starts a child JVM" leaves out a .sh test (tests/concurrentPrinting.sh, run through FileTests.ShellTest).

Notes on the kept entries, none of them a fail: F-113's quoted failure text is not in its cited report, but the code produces it (MainWrapper.java:74, InstantiatingClassloader.java:152). F-117's list of the cell's tests leaves out MutableTopLevelVar, which has no variable of arrow type either.

I assessed all 13 entries of chunk f9 on main at 4caa90c81. The table, the six marks with their reasons and a quoted passage for each fail are in /home/user/fortress/explorations/coordinator/consolidation-2026-10-22/evidence/facts/f9/assessment.md. It mixes four subjects: the checker's in-declaration bound and arrow fold, library edits already owned by F-242, F-85 and F-243, walk's history at 2b1cd8e63 and 743eb5286 (owned by F-253), and the identities' CastError (F-85 and row 436). Its "FortressLibrary.fss:130 stayed" holds on rung L's tree only, does not say so, and conflicts with F-254 ("is out of both"). When it is cut down, repoint F-85 and F-242.
- F-255: reorganize. Most of its 2,771 characters walk through code by line number, and the count move 35 to 34 / 31 to 30 does not say it is rung X's measurement. Its title claims "is that type exactly where the constraints hold", but excludesClause and ancestors read a conditional parent at every instance (report section 10, confirmed in the code). Also, the throws clause and contract it says are "checked without them" are dropped by the disambiguator (row 781).
